notes.title: Version 1.0 - We Have Lift Off!!!
notes.content:
We are glad to announce that version 1.0 is now available!!!
Party at Marie’s! Drinks are on Jack!!!


First off we would like to thank you for your continued support. Things got derailed so many times over the last few years, but you have stuck with us thus far and for that know that you are truly appreciated.


Then, even after some major bug slaying the possibility of something not working quite as it should still remains. Should you come across something fishy, drop us a line in the forums and we’ll do our best to vent that bad boy as soon as we can.
Do note however that due to how the engine has been slapped together there is a known issue we just can’t get around. Rapid clicking through NPC dialogue after a load crashes the game and none of our squirrels have been able to figure out how to get around this problem permanently.
If you run across this problem, close the error message and hit “[b]Alt[/b]” on your keyboard to access the menu bar at the top of the screen. Then select “[b]View[/b]” followed by “[b]Reload[/b]” to return to the main menu. From there a simple click on “[b]Continue[/b]” will get you back to the action faster than a ninja otter in a skillet.


Also, we’re happy to announce that work on Flerynx has started up again, so hopefully we’ll have more to share about that soon. ([b]*Whispers:*[/b] We’re busy with the other playable characters and we’re having trouble sitting still long enough to get any real work done without jumping up to squeal and dance around like little kids in a candy store every few minutes.)


And then lastly, remember our launch week 20% discount. Tell your friends, family and that pesky neighbor about StarStruck. Get him out of your hair for a while by dumping him into a choose your own adventure novel with a potential of 160,000+ words. If you’re lucky he might just decide to stay in space and leave your hedges alone.


Thank you for your support once more, we appreciate it.
We hope you enjoy/enjoyed StarStruck.
Keep an eye out for the free OST DLC in the future.
And then the achievements and trading cards after that.


We’ll see you amongst the stars!
Have a stellar day~

notes.title: 1.0 incoming!!!
notes.content:
Woohoo!!! Here we go!

We’re happy to announce that [b]v1.0 (full release)[/b] will be hitting the Steam store on the [b]15th of May![/b]
It’s been a long road and a myriad of problems had to be slayed and vaporized, but we’re finally here!


[h2][b][u]What makes 1.0 different to the current early access version?[/u][/b][/h2]


[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] The majority, if not all, of the bugs and issues have been sorted out.
[*] Several game breaking problems have been fixed.
[*] A LOT of dialogue based issues have been fixed. (So, so many. . .)
[/list]


[b]Immersion[/b]
[list]
[*] All the ambient music tracks have been added to the game, bringing the total up to a whopping 80+ songs to make your journey more memorable! So crank it up when you find your jam! Or keep it low for the ambiance (recommended).
[*] Many more sound- and visual effects have been added, giving the immersion factor just a little extra nudge.
[*] All backgrounds/scenes have been added to the game, so no more black screens with text, unless it was intended that way.
[/list]


[b]System[/b]
[list]
[*] In 1.0 we got rid of the manual save feature entirely and instead added many, many, many checkpoints where the game saves automatically in tandem with the first implemented major checkpoint saves.
[*] The Continue button now functions as a quick way to get back into the story between major saves, while the load menu is solely there for the major checkpoints. It also serves as a quick start should you not have played the game before, or if (for some reason) you deleted or lost all your save files.
[*] Added a credit button to the main menu.
[*] The ingame menu was changed to remove the manual save button.
[*] Hotkeys to access the menus ingame have been added and the default system menus have been obliterated.
[/list]



To commemorate the full release of StarStruck we’re planning on chopping the price by 20% for a week come release day, so tell your friends, neighbors and archnemeses. Unfortunately this won’t mean much if you already own the game. Sorry about that. . . Blame the space rats for absconding with your hard earned loot, and accept our sincere gratitude for supporting this project.


We hope to see you all cruising the cosmos come Wednesday.

Have a stellar day~

notes.title: v0.9.2
notes.content:
Phew, continued delays due to the ongoing power grid failures and the really weird weather we’re getting this season, as well as intermittent health issues, is really starting to get me under. . . Good thing the holidays are almost upon us. Most of us need a good break!

Update 0.9.2 fixes most of the issues that were still lurking about with the “newly” added manual save system and options menu. If you do happen across one or two more, please don’t hesitate to drop us a line in the forums. There were quite a few dialogue tweaks during the latter half of the game as well.

The next update, I’m crossing my fingers on this one, should be version 1.0. Early access is finally coming to a close! Woot woot!

[b]What will be included in v1.0:[/b]
- Some fine-tuning of the save system to allow for more streamlined data capture that will hopefully get rid of the “saving while animations are running’ problem
- A few new backgrounds as required
- Some updates to existing backgrounds and assets
- Music and SFX where still needed
- Any and all bugs found along the way including possible dialogue tweaks

Getting ready for v1.0 is quite an undertaking, so this might take a while. With everybody on this side getting ready to move to Canada during the second half of next year, this might be an even longer wait, so we really appreciate your patience and understanding on this matter.

And before I forget! If you haven’t seen it already, here’s the preview of that new title we’ve started work on recently I promised you a while back. Give it a gander and if it gets you looking forward to our new title as much as we are, then go ahead and give us a like and a share:

[previewyoutube=Onz7sAvNWfM;full][/previewyoutube]

That’s all for now, so from us to you, we wish you a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! Until 2024 and beyond, peace to you and your families, and we hope you have a stellar time~

notes.title: Health and the future~
notes.content:
Phew! Glad that’s just about over and done with. I ran afoul of an eight legged monster (Brown Recluse spider) around three and a half months ago, an event that left my one arm rendered incapacitated for quite an extended period of time. After several recurring infections and swelling that had me resemble an overly zealous bodybuilder with balancing troubles, my “fat” arm finally got cut open and, as a friend continues to joke every opportunity she gets, all the spiderlings were removed (spoiler alert: There were no spiderlings). Yeah. . . Fun times. Just about healed up, but this appendage o’mine is still a bit dumb and lazy. Also seems like I’ve finally kicked this head cold to the curb.

So with that behind us, we now look to the stars once more!
While recovering StarStruck took a bit of a backseat, a position it will hopefully not occupy for much longer. You can expect a small update in the immediate future that will fix some dialogue issues and smooth out a few wrinkles with the “new” save system implemented not too long ago. Beyond that we have come up with a few ideas to improve upon said system, an endeavor that will be tackled as soon as we finalize a few more details.

Now beyond StarStruck we have started work on another project, something I’m actually looking forward to quite a bit. Moving away from the tons of dialogue that go into making a Visual Novel, this new entry will be a sidescroller Metroidvania roguelike. We’re just about done with the majority of the planning and with setting up the base character, and we’re aiming for a bit of a showcase by the end of this month, should nothing pop up to hinder our progress. A word of warning: Hold onto your socks!!! And if, like me, you don’t really wear socks, well. . . Prepare to be blown away!

That is all for now.
Thank you for your continued support.

Have a stellar day~

notes.title: Update 0.9.1!!!
notes.content:
Had a few hiccups along the line, but here we are. The long awaited update 0.9.1!!!
So what’s new?

[u][b]Main menu overhaul[/b][/u]
-A continue button has been added to allow you to continue your adventure from your last saved location with the click of a button.
	[list][*] [b]Warning![/b] Do not click this button until you’ve at least reached a new save point or manually saved your game first![/list]-You can now access the options menu from the main menu

[u][b]Manual save feature[/b][/u]
-It is now possible to save your game virtually anywhere during your adventures, instead of having to play up to an automatic save point.
	[list][*] [b]Warning[/b]! Please wait for all text and animations to come to a complete stop before you hit the save button. Doing so before everything comes to a standstill can and will result in problems when you load your progress later. It is how the engine was built and we can’t do anything about it without potentially breaking everything.
[/list]
[u][b]Options menu[/b][/u]
-StarStruck now has a working options menu you can access from both the main menu and nearly anywhere in the game itself.
This menu allows you to:
[list]
[*] 	Set your game to fullscreen or windowed
[*] 	Adjust text speed (default recommended speed is about 80%, 8 stars)
[*] 	Adjust music volume
[*] 	Adjust sound effects volume
[/list]
[u][b]Escape menu[/b][/u]
Clicking on the "exit" button or hitting “[b]Esc[/b]” on your keyboard will now bring you to the escape menu where you can
[list][*] 	Return to the main menu
[*] 	Exit to desktop
[*] 	Cancel and go back to your adventures
[/list]The “[b]End[/b]” button on your keyboard will still instantly close your game without saving and without opening any menus. Almost like Alt + F4, but bound to a single button instead.

These features have been tested and should work with no problems up to chapter 3. Testing and fixing any issues with these features is an ongoing process. If you run across any problems please report them in the StarStruck forums on Steam.

Thank you for your support.
Have a stellar day~

notes.title: Upcoming update: 0.9.1
notes.content:
The power situation for our area has not improved at all, still leaving us in the dark for half the day at the best of times; causing all sorts of delays and inconveniences. This along with the rampant rampage of seasonal sniffles and sneeze storms had us pondering our next steps to world domina- *[i]cough[/i]* in regards to our release priorities. As such we have decided to move up the release time frame of update 0.9.1, but even then it is taking longer than we anticipated.

[u][b]What will 0.9.1 bring to StarStruck?[/b][/u]

[b]- A working settings menu.[/b]
[list]
[*] 	- Fullscreen and windowed toggles
[*] 	- Text speed adjustment slider
[*] 	- Volume controls for both background music and sound effects
[/list]
[b]- A revamped main menu[/b]
[list]
[*] 	- A new quick load feature to make the continuation of your adventure easier and less time consuming
[*] 	- Access to the settings menu before you even set off on your intergalactic exploits
[/list]
And the addition we are the most excited about:
[list]
[*] [b]A manual save feature[/b] that allows you to save your journey at the drop of a hat.
[/list]

Now with the availability of electricity limited and sporadic at times, and the continuous struggle with colds, flu and less savory outbreaks due to the governing body's managerial neglect, we don’t have any predetermined deadline for this update, but hopefully the incoming quality of life additions will leave you salivating and looking forward to when the release finally does drop.

Thank you for your continued support and patience.
Have a stellar day~

notes.title: Patch notes for 23 Mar
notes.content:
Phew! My neighborhood got hit hard with outages this past month, sometimes leaving us in the dark for more than sixteen (16) hours at a time. . . Bundles of fun that. At least the storms are slowly starting to taper off with winter on the way, so that's one less thing to have to deal with.

[u][b]So what's new in 0.9.0.3?[/b][/u]

- Adjusted the volume of some BGMs and SFXs.
- Added a few new BGMs to scenes that didn't have any.
- Added some new sound effects.
- Fixed typos and other text related problems.
- Fixed a few animations not quite doing what they are supposed to.
- Fixed a few minor issues with dialogue transitions.

Enjoy, and have a stellar day~ =)

notes.title: Patch notes for 7 Feb 2023
notes.content:
Bringing out a minor update today to address a few issues.

- Some minor tweaks to the main menu to prevent multiple Winter messages from being opened simultaneously.
- Fixed the lingering hotspot when you return to the main menu after going to the loading menu. It will now no longer 'click' you into madness one mouseover at a time.
- Added a warning to the intro regarding save progress and leaving the game before reaching a save point. Now you have been warned!
- Changed [b]Escape[/b] to no longer close the game. It will now open up the built in settings menu where applicable along with [b]right-click[/b]. The keyboard shortcut to close the game is now set to [b]End[/b] (Usually next to Delete).
- Added a message to the end credits.

Thank you for your support.
Have a stellar day! =)
